text: The island needs you. Now and then, while you play, trouble comes to one of your villages: for a start, a fire in the woods that the wind carries toward the houses. The island shows it and says what is seen, nothing more. What you do about it is yours to invent, and the island waits while you are on the Craft tab. A village you saved raises a stone to the item that did it, and that item's card remembers. A new island's first troubles take one house at most. You can turn troubles off in the new island dialog.
